title: Exceptional adjoint of proper coefficient pushforward
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and finite coefficient conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $c=(c_1,c_2):C\to X\times_kX$ and $b=(b_1,b_2):D\to Y\times_kY$ be admissible correspondences [def-trf-correspondence] of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and let $(f,g):(C,c)\to(D,b)$ be a proper pushforward diagram [def-trf-coefficient-pushforward]: $f:X\to Y$ and $g:C\to D$ are proper and $b_ig=fc_i$ for $i=1,2$. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and $u:c_2^*K\to c_1^!K$, and denote its exceptional adjoint by $v:Rc_{1!}c_2^*K\to K$ [def-trf-admissibility]. Put $K'=Rf_*K$. Let
$$\gamma:b_2^*K'\to Rg_*c_2^*K,\qquad
\Xi_1:Rb_{1!}Rg_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*Rc_{1!}$$
be respectively the ordinary unit/counit map and the proper composition comparison specified in [def-trf-coefficient-pushforward]. The exceptional adjoint of the coefficient pushforward $[f,g]_!u$ is exactly
$$Rb_{1!}b_2^*K'\xrightarrow{Rb_{1!}\gamma}Rb_{1!}Rg_*c_2^*K\xrightarrow{\Xi_1}Rf_*Rc_{1!}c_2^*K\xrightarrow{Rf_*v}Rf_*K.$$
Neither leg square is assumed Cartesian, and none of the schemes is assumed proper over $k$.
